chapter: Sunset Cafe, Pass in Review and rebuilding the band
title: Jabbo Smith, Leon Scott and rival-to-Armstrong rumors
summary: Jabbo Smith stayed in the Sunset band a short time, replaced by Leon Scott; Randolph is unsure about attempts to build Jabbo as an Armstrong rival.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, was Jabbo Smith featured a lot with that band?
Yes. He stayed there a while. He didn't stay long. And then we got a fellow by the name of Leon Scott. He's dead, now.
Scottie, yes. Nice little trumpet player.
Yeah. Well, there was some attempt, I believe, back then to build Jabbo Smith to be a rival of Louis'. You know, the record companies and other people.
Well, I don't know. You know, some-

times they had those little hidden things going on, and maybe you don't know -- I don't know about it, you know. Maybe the journalists or something like that and the media might know something. But as far as some of the musicians, they keep some of those things here, because here's the way this turned out.
